scope: Close and fence the native get_status top-level contract while the complete config migration/normalization projection remains partial.

topLevelContract.ok: boolean true on successful status production
topLevelContract.xluaOnline: same route-presence boolean that selects named-pipe backend
topLevelContract.lastXluaActivity: Unix-ms scalar; max of stored bridge activity and selected-route activity timestamps
topLevelContract.config: generic JSON value after native config load/migration/normalization

configBoundary.reason: large path-based migration/default/validation routine spans scheduler, tasks, chat, trade station, hotkeys, visual metrics, alliance/train/railway, equipment, stamina and related retained config

currentRebuildDeviation: nullable pending when local RPC state is absent
xluaOnline uses Overview heartbeat readiness instead of native route presence
config is a hand-built four-flag plus tasks subset
generic optional-profile scope gate differs from native selected-runtime resolver

decision.action: Do not claim get_status parity or replace the current projection with another partial projection until native config normalization is closed.

nextCheckpoint: Move to another fully closable retained host/status contract; resume get_status implementation only when the complete native config normalizer is recovered.
